data.description: Lifecycle contract v2 returns one canonical injectionPrompt plus metadata-only rules and addressable sections with stable ids, resource versions, UTF-8 byte ranges and rendered-content versions. All four hooks remain mandatory. run.start supplies applicable project-specific rules and custom memory/fixed-hook instructions, a bounded current memory summary and, for design/implementation, a metadata-only design index. Generic Adashi workflow and API manuals belong in agents_template.md and on-demand operation help, never built-in startup prompts. Known historical built-in prompts are migrated to empty defaults without deleting custom project instructions. Empty rules do not suppress other sections; status=empty identifies an empty hook. Clients cache sections only while their content remains in active context.
data.name: Lifecycle Rule Injection API
data.technology: MCP tool, SQL, generated design context
